description: List commitfest entries (proposed patch series). Filterable by status, commitfest number, or topic; paginated.

commitfest_number.description: Restrict to entries from this commitfest (e.g. 59)

status.description: Status keyword without leading colon, e.g. needs-review, ready-for-committer, waiting-on-author, committed, withdrawn, returned-with-feedback

topic.description: Restrict to entries with this :entry/topic value (substring match)

name: list_entries
